endpoint_url: Dynamo frontend (OpenAI-compatible HTTP API) on the server node

node_types.host_memory_configuration: LPDDR5X SOCAMM; two NUMA nodes, one per Vera CPU (MemTotal 745,599,040 kB and 753,862,912 kB)
node_types.host_network_card_count: 10: 8 ConnectX-9 (InfiniBand, 800 Gb/s XDR each) and 2 BlueField-4 integrated network controllers (2 Ethernet ports each, 400 Gb/s)
node_types.host_storage_capacity: 32.6 TB (4 x 7.68 TB + 1 x 1.92 TB NVMe)
node_types.host_storage_type: NVMe SSD: 4 x Micron MTFDMBT7T6THM 7.68 TB and 1 x Micron MTFDLBT1T9THG 1.92 TB; /raid is a 6.0 TB ext4 LVM volume used as per-allocation scratch
node_types.hw_notes: GPU HBM clocks locked to 4752 MHz on all four GPUs (nvidia-smi -lmc 4752,4752); the workflow checks the lock before launch. Client and Dynamo frontend share the server node; no switch hops.
node_types.filesystem: Lustre (shared models, datasets and results); ext4 on /raid (per-allocation scratch)
node_types.other_software_stack: CUDA 13.4.1; vLLM 0.20.2rc1.dev6106+g7cf5542c2.d20261003.cu134; Torch 2.15.0.dev20260908+cu134; Transformers 5.18.0; Protobuf 7.36.2; ai-dynamo 1.6.0.dev20260924; Endpoints clients 4235a9c and d3c57f2 (per-point mapping in docs/software_disclosure.md)
node_types.sw_notes: Each vLLM worker runs on 12 dedicated physical cores of its GPU's CPU socket with its memory bound there (numactl --physcpubind/--membind); the Dynamo frontend and the endpoint client run on the remaining CPUs. Dynamo frontend tokenizer prefix cache 16 GB (C2048) / 32 GB (C3072) with DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_EXTEND=1. Rubin kernels: FlashMLA sm_107a, DeepGEMM MegaMoE SM107 with per-die routing (branch dsv41-rubin-megamoe-sm107), Rubin MXFP8 dense GEMM dispatch.

node_config: One four-GPU node. Concurrency 2048 and 3072 both use four vLLM data-parallel ranks (one GPU each) forming one expert-parallel group; 512 (2048) or 768 (3072) sequences per rank.
config_summary: DEP4 (DP4 attention + EP4 MoE) vLLM workers behind a Dynamo frontend (round-robin, 3600 s session affinity); DSpark speculative decoding (k=5, adaptive verification); FP8 (fp8_ds_mla) KV cache.
config_summary_notes: Parallelism fields describe one model replica: the four TP1 ranks form a single 4-way expert-parallel group (EP4) and run attention data-parallel inside it (DEP4, as in config_summary), so data_parallel is 1 and the replica engages all four GPUs.
model_notes: Original mixed-precision checkpoint: MXFP4 MoE expert weights and FP8 weights with 32x32 UE8M0 block scales (quant_method=fp8, expert_dtype=fp4); unquantized tensors retain BF16. No submitter weight quantization or calibration. Runtime uses fp8_ds_mla KV cache, MXFP4 indexer KV, sparse indexer logits and dynamic MXFP8 activation quantization; see docs/calibration.adoc.
